real_combination.cdc_fixture: Two-stage selected-clock quiesce/resume synchronizers and two-stage 50MHz quiet/drain/prefill/running acknowledgements. Flush clears return ACKs. Production domain reset chain remains real.
real_combination.response_fixture: Ordinary bounded8..12 selected-MCLK-cycle tagged response. Before each normal switch, inject one512-MCLK-cycle in-flight response. Quiesce does not cancel its timer: complete the full latency, explicitly discard the old result, then idle. No acknowledgement tied constant.
real_combination.failure_recovery: Stop active 48k reference high during playback; expect fault code6, local async serializer reset without source edges, then requalify and explicit recover at committed48k, new epoch3.
real_combination.pin_decode: Count true selected MCLK edges for BCK /4 or /6 and LRCK /256 or /384, decode actual BCK rising edges/I2S delay/zero padding, compare physical PCM to completed frame tap and expected identity.

drain_proof.required_state_during_wait: QUIESCE with local audio reset released
drain_proof.limitation: Fixture models noncancellable finite-latency response; no actual DSP or production CDC bridge is integrated.
